title: Zacchaeus the Tax Collector
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Luke 19:2-10: a rich chief tax collector climbs a tree to see Jesus, Jesus goes to his house, the people grumble, Zacchaeus gives half to the poor and pays back four times what he cheated; repenting means turning from wrong.

floor.prerequisite: Knows that taking what belongs to others is wrong.
floor.question: Is it right to keep money that belongs to someone else?

representations: a drawing of a crowd and a man in a tree
a two-column chart: Zacchaeus before and after
steps: Who was Zacchaeus and why was he disliked?
Why did he climb the tree?
What did Jesus say and what did the people say?
What did Zacchaeus promise: half to the poor, four times back.
contexts: a child who returns change wrongly given
a matatu tout who keeps a passenger's change

board.do: Draw a crowd and a tree.
Point at the man in the tree.
Wait for the child to say he was short and wanted to see Jesus.
Write "before" and "after" and fill in how he changed.

misconceptions.ask: What did Zacchaeus promise to give to the poor?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 19:8 and underline half and four times.

listen_for: They were glad and thanked Jesus
misconceptions.ask: What did the people say when Jesus went to Zacchaeus' house?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 19:7 and ask why they grumbled.

listen_for: To say sorry in words and go on as before
misconceptions.ask: What does it mean to repent?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what Zacchaeus did that showed he meant it.

misconceptions.ask: Why did Zacchaeus climb the sycamore-fig tree (Luke 19:3-4)?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 19:3-4 aloud and act it: a short child behind a crowd cannot see. Zacchaeus wanted to see Jesus.

checks.question: How much did Zacchaeus promise to pay back to anyone he cheated?
What does it mean to repent?
checks.answer: To be sorry and turn away from the wrong
